newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Sax index falls on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Sax index falls on weak demand.

text.p: Slovak blue chips were mixed in thin trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday, as weak demand in most of the issues pulled the 16-share SAX index down 0.18 points to 196.9.
"What we see is certainly a quiet period," Peter Lachkovic of Slovenska Sporitelna said.
Steel maker VSZ dominated trading on the BSE floor, with 2,947 shares, closing unchanged at 745 crowns.
"Despite its current stability, I expect VSZ to ease at the end of the month," Lachkovic said.
"It (VSZ) has been plotting a stable course for a long time, but now, before the AGM, it is probably better to sell than to buy this issue," he added.
Other blue chips traded only low volumes, on mixed prices.
Overall, volume fell to 190,189 shares, from 195,174 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover increased to 156.6 million crowns, from 77.35 million.
